title: Nice Ziplock bag four-organizer set to put in a drawer but mismatched sizes
text:
Nice Ziplock bag four-organizer set to put in a drawer but mismatched sizes. There are four individual Ziplock bag organizers in this set. There is one separate organizer each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. This can be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it, several drawers, or on a counter. There are 16 silicone circles provided so that they can be affixed in each corner on the bottom to keep each one from sliding around which is great to protect the wall or counter.

Overall, this is a decent organizer set that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. What I do not like is that this seems to be designed to fit in the shipping box as all but the quarter organizers are oversized. The quart organizer is narrow and tiny. To me this is very odd but it fits well in the shipping box like this (see photo). The current price of $19.99 is reasonable for this. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For those looking to store foil and plastic wrap with their bags, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.
